images.description: High resolution cylindrical grow chamber photographed through a round black bolted hatch; reflective walls, overhead lighting, green plants and central walkway. Embedded first by user source; its provenance as actual historical BIOS-3 is not independently established.
Cutaway physical scale model of BIOS-3 with four rectangular compartments, planted beds, numbered arrows and dark outer panels.
Black and white historical photograph of two people speaking through a large round bolted hatch; rectangular metal exterior panels, pipe and handrail.
Phytotron growing room: crop rows, metal trellis grid, white ceiling, hanging lamp columns.
Official Institute of Biophysics photo: planted wheat phytotron with researcher, reflective metal walls, white ceiling and upright pipes.
Official Institute of Biophysics photo: rectangular BIOS-3 scale model with dark red panels, circular portholes and overhead service piping.
Metal vacuum/physics laboratory apparatus with analogue control cabinets. Article covers multiple labs: do NOT describe this image as BIOS-3.
2019 visitor group inside BIOS-3; stainless steel wall cabinets, brown rectangular wall framing, large round porthole door, control equipment partly visible.
